messages:
Aisha K: hi all, trying to figure out lifecycle for Notion templates. If I make a new onboarding checklist for my team, how do I later promote it org-wide or deprecate an old template?
Maya (DevEx): welcome Aisha :wave: good q. High level: team-owned templates stay in Docs > eng > <team> and org templates live in Docs > Templates > Team templates. Promotion is a controlled process so we review for duplicates/quality.
Harper: and deprecation? we had an old interview-kit that confused folks last quarter. How do we mark something deprecated so people stop copying it?
Maya (DevEx): we add a `template_status` page property: `approved`, `candidate`, or `deprecated`. Deprecated templates should have the page title prefixed with `DEPRECATED:` and a short note at top listing replacement templates. We also keep a redirect table in Templates index.
Aisha K: ok. What's the exact flow to promote: do I move the page myself or does Docs Ops do it?
Maya (DevEx): preferred flow: 1) Duplicate your team page, 2) Move the duplicate to Docs > Templates > Drafts, 3) Set `template_status` = "candidate" and add `rationale` and `example_use_cases` properties, 4) Open a PR in the templates tracker (link at top of Templates), 5) Docs/Design reviews and either approve (set `template_status` = approved) or request changes. We avoid moving original team-owned pages directly to Templates to preserve team control.
Aisha K: gotcha. Side question: I tried to invite eng@redwood.com but Notion auto-suggest offered eng-team@ instead and I wasn't sure which to pick.
Harper: same confusion here. I've accidentally invited eng-team@ and the page access behaved differently.
Maya (DevEx): canonical groups: eng@redwood.com = org-wide engineering editors. eng-team@redwood.com = calendar alias only (do not use for docs). If auto-suggest shows the wrong one, type the full group email or use the "Invite by email" field.
Aisha K: great — one weird error: when I tried to move the duplicate into Templates > Drafts I got "You don't have permission to move this page". The duplicate is in my private workspace.
Docs Ops: that happens when the Templates space restricts moves to Docs Ops. Reply with "please transfer" and we'll open an ops ticket and preserve history.
Aisha K: please transfer. Page id: a1b2c3d4
templates-bot: Ticket created: TPL-512 — "Transfer candidate template a1b2c3d4 -> Templates/Drafts". Assignee: Docs Ops. https://tickets.redwood.com/TPL-512
Harper: nice. Any naming conventions for templates to make discovery easier?
Maya (DevEx): yes — prefix with area then short name, kebab-case. examples: `tpl-onboard-mini`, `tpl-runbook-basic`. Add tags in the top of the page: `audience: new-hires`, `owner: <team>`.
Aisha K: and retention? how long do templates stick around once deprecated?
Maya (DevEx): deprecated templates remain for 12 months then archived to the templates-archive space. We patch redirects in the Templates index during that period so copy actions point to replacements. If you spot live copies of a deprecated tpl, ping #devex and we'll update or nudge owners.
Harper: last thing — who can create new groups like <team>@redwood.com? I might want a `platform-tools@` group for narrower edits.
Docs Ops: groups are created by People Ops. Open a People Ops request and include the group name, list of members, and intended use. Docs Ops can advise on permission boundaries if you include the doc space link.
Aisha K: thanks everyone, that'll help. After TPL-512 is closed I'll follow the promote checklist and open a PR in the templates tracker. Appreciate the quick answers!
Maya (DevEx): welcome! ping me if you want a quick review before submitting the PR :thumbsup:
